summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with malaise, body aches, tremors, and urinary symptoms including dysuria and hesitancy. She had a history of type 1 diabetes, end-stage renal disease on peritoneal dialysis, gastroparesis, and recent hip fracture. Evaluation revealed pyuria suggestive of a complicated urinary tract infection, despite negative cultures. She was treated with ciprofloxacin and showed clinical improvement. Mild confusion on admission resolved, attributed to infection and possible deliriogenic medications. Her nortriptyline was reduced, and thyroid function tests indicated a need for levothyroxine dose review. She remained stable, completed treatment, and was discharged home with instructions to continue antibiotics and follow up with her primary care provider.
problems: Urinary tract infection, site not specified
